clips.send: The socialist market economy. It joins the socialist system with a market economy. The market plays the decisive role in deciding where resources go. The government also plays its role — planning, regulating, keeping competition fair. “The state practises a socialist market economy” has been in the Constitution since 1993.

clips.send: The people’s congress system. The people’s congress system is China’s fundamental political system. The people elect deputies; the deputies form people’s congresses at every level — the organs of state power. The congresses create the government, supervisory commissions, courts and procuratorates, which answer to them. Deputies can discuss reports and bills, vote, put forward motions and question state organs. The textbook: this system unites the leadership of the Party, the people running the country, and law-based governance.

clips.send: Community-level self-governance. People in villages and city neighbourhoods run their own community affairs. Villagers’ committees (村民委员会) and urban residents’ committees (居民委员会) are self-governing organisations of local people. Residents elect the committee members directly. The idea: self-management, self-education, self-service and self-supervision. Typical jobs: settling neighbours’ disputes, public hygiene, deciding how to use collective funds.

clips.send: Distribution according to work as the main form. Pay according to work is the main form; other forms of distribution exist beside it. According to work: more work, more pay; less work, less pay. Other forms: income from the “factors of production” someone contributes — labour, capital, land, knowledge, technology, management, data. The goal the textbook names: common prosperity for all the people, step by step.

clips.send: Multi-party cooperation and political consultation. Led by the Communist Party of China (CPC); a basic political system of China. The CPC is the governing party. Eight other parties (“democratic parties”) are participating parties: they take part in state affairs. They work with the CPC as partners — the textbook calls them friendly parties, not opposition parties. Guiding principle: “long-term coexistence, mutual supervision, sincerity with each other, sharing weal and woe”. The Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (人民政协, CPPCC) is the main body for this cooperation: it consults, supervises democratically, and takes part in discussing state affairs.

clips.send: Regional ethnic autonomy. Under the unified leadership of the state, areas where minority ethnic groups live in concentrated communities practise regional autonomy. China has 56 ethnic groups; the Constitution says all are equal. Autonomous areas come in three sizes: autonomous regions, prefectures and counties. The five autonomous regions are Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Guangxi, Ningxia and Tibet. Their people’s congresses and governments can make rules that fit local ethnic customs and culture. Every autonomous area is an inseparable part of the People’s Republic of China.

clips.send: Public ownership as the mainstay. Public ownership is the mainstay, and different kinds of ownership grow side by side. Public sector: the state-owned economy, the collective economy, and the state or collective shares in mixed companies. The state-owned economy is the “leading force” of the national economy. Non-public sector: individual businesses, private companies, foreign-invested companies — an important part of the socialist market economy. “Two unswervinglys”: strengthen the public sector; encourage, support and guide the non-public sector.

clips.send: 人民代表大会制度。人民代表大会制度是我国的根本政治制度。人民通过民主选举选出代表，组成各级人民代表大会，作为国家权力机关。国家行政机关、监察机关、审判机关、检察机关都由人民代表大会产生，对它负责，受它监督。人大代表依法行使审议权、表决权、提案权和质询权。人民代表大会制度是坚持党的领导、人民当家作主、依法治国有机统一的根本政治制度安排。

clips.send: 基层群众自治制度。人民群众在城乡基层直接行使民主权利，管理基层公共事务和公益事业。村民委员会和居民委员会是基层群众性自治组织。村（居）民委员会成员由村（居）民直接选举产生。实行自我管理、自我教育、自我服务、自我监督；实行民主选举、民主协商、民主决策、民主管理、民主监督。例如：调解邻里纠纷、维护公共卫生、讨论决定集体资金的使用。

clips.send: 民族区域自治制度。在国家统一领导下，各少数民族聚居的地方实行区域自治，设立自治机关，行使自治权。我国有56个民族，各民族一律平等。民族自治地方分为自治区、自治州、自治县三级；五个自治区是内蒙古、新疆维吾尔、广西壮族、宁夏回族、西藏自治区。自治机关（自治地方的人民代表大会和人民政府）依法行使自治权，可以依照当地民族的特点制定自治条例和单行条例。各民族自治地方都是中华人民共和国不可分离的部分。

clips.send: 社会主义市场经济体制。社会主义市场经济体制把社会主义制度和市场经济有机结合起来。使市场在资源配置中起决定性作用。更好发挥政府作用：科学的宏观调控、有效的政府治理。1993年宪法修正案写入“国家实行社会主义市场经济”。

clips.send: 中国共产党领导的多党合作和政治协商制度。中国共产党领导的多党合作和政治协商制度是我国的一项基本政治制度。中国共产党是执政党，各民主党派是参政党（共八个民主党派）。中国共产党和各民主党派是通力合作的友党关系，不是反对党、在野党。基本方针：长期共存、互相监督、肝胆相照、荣辱与共。中国人民政治协商会议（人民政协）是中国共产党领导的多党合作和政治协商的重要机构，履行政治协商、民主监督、参政议政的职能。

clips.send: 公有制为主体、多种所有制经济共同发展。公有制为主体、多种所有制经济共同发展。公有制经济包括国有经济、集体经济，以及混合所有制经济中的国有成分和集体成分。国有经济是国民经济的主导力量。非公有制经济包括个体经济、私营经济、外资经济等，是社会主义市场经济的重要组成部分。坚持“两个毫不动摇”：毫不动摇巩固和发展公有制经济，毫不动摇鼓励、支持、引导非公有制经济发展。
